overall_summary: Data shows clear audience preference towards 'self respect' and boundary-setting themes (e.g., deleting chats, removing numbers, muting statuses) yielding higher average views (30-40 views) compared to generic overthinking or late-night sadness tropes which stagnated at lower views (5-20 views).

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'AfaLxMy6FMY' (Self Respect, 40 views), 'wFimeeP_aVc' (35 views), and 'rwOUYo_hayQ' (39 views) outperform passive sadness content.
winning_patterns.action: Focus storytelling on micro-decisions of walking away or reclaiming dignity (like muting, deleting, hiding stories).

winning_patterns.evidence: Hooks mentioning specific smartphone interface elements like blue ticks, pinned chats, and status lists generate better immediate traction.
winning_patterns.action: Open hooks with physical actions on the phone screen related to cutting access.

weak_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'uIbMpCjVutQ' ('मेज पर रखी चाय ठंडी हो गई') got only 5 views.
weak_patterns.action: Avoid overly poetic, slow-burn setups; keep hooks grounded in modern digital relationship realities.
